name: Runout
summary: A coral and black money app for a record label, with a drag-and-drop six-week cash planner
about: A money app for a small business that sees its cash, plans its payments and chases what it is owed, shown with an independent record label's sample data. Every planned payment is a card in one of six weekly columns: drag it to another week and the running balance line and each week's ending cash update, with tight weeks turning red. Auto-plan pushes movable costs later, the chase list writes friendly, firm or final reminders, and artists' royalties are paid in a batch.
how: Drag payment cards between weeks on the Planner, or press a card's ••• and pick a week
Press Auto-plan to move flexible costs until every week clears your cash floor
Chase an invoice: pick a tone and channel, preview the message and send it
Log a promise to pay and watch it appear in the planner, or mark the invoice paid
Tick artists on Royalties and pay them in one go from the royalty account
Move money between accounts with a confirm step and freeze the label card
